newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan says to urge U.S. to grant telecoms licences.
newsitem.headline: Japan says to urge U.S. to grant telecoms licences.

text.p: Japan's Posts and Telecommunications Minister Hisao Horinouchi said on Friday Japan will call on the United States to quickly grant U.S. telephone licences to Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) and Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD).
"We will seek further explanation from the United States about the issue and will seek quick U.S. approval of the licences," Horinouchi told a news conference.

The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has informed NTT that it will delay granting it a U.S. licence to provide international phone services. KDD's application for a U.S. licence has been similarly delayed.

Japanese media reports linked the delay in approving the licences to U.S. irritation with Tokyo's insistence on keeping a 20 percent ceiling on foreign investment in NTT and KDD and to U.S. pressure to open up Japan's telecoms equipment market.
